units.source_text: 请看吧，当时我从残疾人停止在那里同时也到达了那里的理论，和绝对不会招来不安的理论，

en.t: Look, at that time, from the theory that a disabled person could stop there and at the same time reach that place, and from the theory that this would never invite anxiety,

units.source_text: 发明了我自己的情欲的理论，发明了类似人世间称做"耽溺"的一种虚构。

en.t: I invented my own theory of desire, and invented a fiction resembling what people in the world call "indulgence."

units.source_text: 对于我来说，这类似隐身革或风的被望的结合，只是一种梦。

en.t: For me, this desired union, like a cloak of invisibility or like the wind, was only a dream.

units.source_text: 我做梦的同时，还必须全面而一无遗漏地梦见！

en.t: While dreaming, I also had to dream completely, without leaving anything out!

units.source_text: 这时候，我的X型的腿、女人都与我保持着相同的距离。

en.t: At that moment, my X-shaped legs and the woman both kept the same distance from me.

units.source_text: 实像摆在那里，欲望只不过是虚像。

en.t: The real image was set there, and desire was nothing more than a virtual image.

units.source_text: 于是，望着实像的我，无限地堕落在虚像中，并冲着实像射精。

en.t: And so I, gazing at the real image, fell endlessly into the virtual image and ejaculated toward the real one.

units.source_text: 我的X型的腿和我的女人，互相绝对不接触，互相绝对不结合，

en.t: My X-shaped legs and my woman absolutely did not touch each other, and absolutely did not unite with each other,

units.source_text: 而互相依然被抛弃在世界之外……

en.t: but instead remained cast away from each other, outside the world...
Desire advanced and rose without end.

units.source_text: 这是因为那双美丽的腿与我的X型的腿已经永远不会再接触了。

en.t: This was because those beautiful legs and my X-shaped legs would never touch again for all eternity.
